text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takamatsunomiya Kinen had 
finally arrived. Namely, the first race of 
the "Kawaii Derby♪"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus's tokusatsu video was edited 
with inspiration from Curren Chan's past 
videos, making it even more impressive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Curren Chan powered through as 
always with a video that went all-in on 
cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While praising each other's uploaded 
videos, they exchanged declarations of 
victory for the upcoming race.
